checks.assertion: capacity: ads held never exceed the cache size
no duplicates: one ad per advertiser and topic per registrar
only registrants: every held ad is from a node registering that topic
only capable nodes: no legacy node in any cache
no self-ads: a registrar never holds its own ad
departed nodes leave caches within an ad lifetime
checks.summary: 2 ads of long-departed nodes; 1 ads from ids without a trace (see H2)

checks.assertion: lifetime: expired ads are swept promptly and no ad expires beyond a lifetime
checks.summary: expired ads lingered 7.0 s (tolerance 5 s); 1 ads with expiry beyond a lifetime

checks.assertion: renewal keeps fan-out: final fan-out against the post-register level
checks.summary: 1 advertisers below 50% of their post-register fan-out (median ratio 1.00)

checks.assertion: renewal accounting: renewals received match renewals sent beyond session setups
checks.summary: churn: a restarted advertiser's fresh REGTOPIC arrives as a renewal where its ad is still held (60 renewals sent, 55 received); A1 checks the totals

checks.assertion: bounded wait: every admission within 2 % of the attempt timeout
no early admission: admitted only after the required wait
lower bound: a repeated quote never undercuts the previous one by more than the time elapsed
checks.summary: 8 of 8 repeated quotes undercut the lower bound

checks.assertion: full cache admits nothing
ticket validity: early, late, wrong-topic and bad-MAC tickets rejected
checks.summary: TicketSealer tests in the fork; rejection counters not traced

checks.assertion: record address: admitted record IP equals the packet source
checks.summary: 20 admissions with a record IP other than the source

checks.assertion: bucket size: registered plus waiting never exceed the bucket size
bucket IP diversity: one registrar per /24 per bucket
checks.summary: 3 buckets with two registrars in one /24

checks.assertion: state maintained: tables complete by search start and no bucket left empty with candidates
right topic: every result registers the requested topic
capable results: no legacy node among results
no expired results: no result down longer than a lifetime
termination: lookups end at the target or the timeout, hit flag consistent
reply limits: nodes per reply within the topic and aux limits
checks.summary: 1 searches saw a reply over the limit (largest 5 registrants, 1 neighbours)

checks.assertion: no duplicate results within a lookup
checks.summary: TypeError: object of type 'int' has no len()

checks.assertion: no topic messages to legacy peers
base discovery: legacy nodes still find providers
request accounting: REGTOPIC and TOPICQUERY sent equal received
checks.summary: REGTOPIC and TOPICQUERY (churn: requests to departed nodes are lost by design): 760 sent, 715 received, difference not within the 30 session setups

checks.assertion: every query answered: TOPICNODES sent at least TOPICQUERY received per node
checks.summary: 1 nodes replied to fewer queries than they received

checks.assertion: registrar load bound: busiest registrar within a multiple of the median
checks.summary: busiest registrar at 1.8× the median (70 vs 40 queries)

checks.assertion: no packet drops on any host
complete collection: a trace for every node
hosts under load: node CPU and host memory within limits
checks.summary: node CPU peak 20%, RSS peak 20 MB, host memory never below 898 MB

checks.assertion: ghosts pinned: every node holds all its assigned ghosts at its last snapshot
ghosts cost timeouts: some ghostTimeouts recorded and every ownGhostTimeouts ≤ ghostTimeouts
